facts: Francis D. Lee's remodel gave the building its Gothic lancets and stained glass, crenellated tower and Tudor entrance.
The Archdale Street elevation has three bays, with a Tudor-arched entrance flanked by two 25-foot lancets. The four-storey tower has a crocketed hood around its major window.

record: South Carolina Department of Archives and History register
facts: The masonry church has a crenellated four-storey tower and lancet windows, following the mid-nineteenth-century remodel.
